source.title: Amplituhedra and origami, I: tree level
source.author: Pavel Galashin

definition_boundary.TE1: every dual edge is a nonzero straight segment
definition_boundary.TE2: each primal interior face maps to a convex polygon with orientation preserved
definition_boundary.TE3: graph weights and Euclidean dual-edge lengths are gauge equivalent with gauge 1 on boundary vertices
definition_boundary.TE4: white and black angle sums at each interior dual vertex are each pi
definition_boundary.TE5: each white and black boundary angle sum lies strictly between 0 and pi
definition_boundary.embedding: a t-embedding is an injective t-immersion

construction_boundary.theorem_1_3: For connected graphs with kmin>=2, t-immersions modulo the stated equivalences correspond to admissible pairs of 2-planes lambda subset C subset tilde-lambda-perp.
construction_boundary.corollary_1_13: Connected, 2-boundary-nondegenerate graphs with kmin>=2 admit a t-embedding for every strictly positive weight system.

surplus.method: exact finite enumeration of nonempty subsets of interior vertices on each color side; for a chosen side subset S the minimal closed opposite-color set is N(S)

steps: enumerate the 31 almost-perfect matchings and compute the nineteen positive boundary-measurement minors
reconstruct a 3x6 representative C using pivot minor Delta_124 and pivot columns 1,2,4
construct a deterministic three-row basis for C-perp
search a deterministic Fibonacci-sphere sequence for oriented 2-planes with positive adjacent determinants and source-required winding
apply a positive-determinant GL2 normalization so the boundary gauge values are unit on the three white-boundary F values and three black-boundary tilde-F values
solve the white- and black-holomorphic extension systems
replay TE1 through TE5 and injectivity/noncrossing independently
forward_constructor.selector_semantics: Finite deterministic representative selector. Failure to find a plane is SELECTOR_COVERAGE_LIMIT and is not evidence of t-embedding nonexistence.

atlas_policy.independence: Every non-baseline sample changes the protected quotient coordinate vector before boundary measurement and realization construction.
